title: MindShift: Analyzing Language Models’ Reactions to Psychological Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting Psychological Bias Descriptors (e.g., Anxiety, Depression, Cynicism) into persona prompts at varying intensities and measuring how language models' responses shift using an adaptation of the Minnesota Multiphasic Personality Inventory (MMPI-2) through indirect True/False statements.

Measuring models' tendencies to overly agree with statements or respond inconsistently by utilizing the built-in validity scales of the MMPI-2, such as True Response Inconsistency (TRIN) and Variable Response Inconsistency (VRIN).
